Only 22% of remote USD jobs on Loker Dollar show a salary figure. The rest are marked DOE—determined on experience. What does that mean for your next negotiation?

Our latest analysis of 4,280 active remote listings found:

• 940 listings (22%) disclose a concrete USD salary.
• 3,340 listings (78%) leave pay blank, signaling DOE.
• 64% (2,735 listings) accept applicants from any country.
• 1,213 listings were posted in the last 7 days.

Example: Online Consumer Panels America pays $25–$45/hour for product assessments—one of the few with a disclosed range.

Contrarian view: A hidden pay figure isn't always a red flag—it can be a negotiation lever. In fields like AI or specialized healthcare, top candidates often push salaries above market averages.

How to negotiate a DOE wage:

1. Research global benchmarks for your role.
2. Quantify your impact with concrete metrics.
3. Anchor with a high-end range.
4. Ask about total compensation—benefits, equity, bonuses.
5. Reference industry trends, like the 'human verification tax' from recent AI efficiency research (Techmeme), to show you understand cost structures.

Ready to find DOE roles that match your skills? Browse the latest DOE listings on Loker Dollar, set your target range, and start the conversation today.
